title: agrostis rupestris subsp. pyrenaica
intro: Agrostis rupestris subsp. pyrenaica, commonly known as Alpine Bentgrass, is a type of grass that is native to mountainous regions. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Bentgrass include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids and phenolic acids. These constituents may also contribute to its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
